description: A specialty referral coordinator must assign the hospital's one available new-patient genetics consultation slot next week and document the appropriate referral pathway for the other patient, with input from a genetic counselor and a patient-access specialist.

shared_context.S1: The genetics service has one available new-patient consultation slot next Wednesday.
shared_context.S2: Maya makes the final assignment and records the referral plan.
shared_context.S3: Rivera and Chen both have active referrals for a genetics consultation.
shared_context.S4: The hospital genetics service provides multidisciplinary counseling and testing coordination, while community genetics providers may offer a different set of services.
shared_context.S5: Before the schedule is finalized, Maya follows the referral team's routine check-in with the genetic counselor and patient-access specialist for relevant clinical and access details.
shared_context.S6: Maya's standard referral-record validation requires an authorization document to be attached whenever the finalized plan relies on an insurance authorization.

PF1.text: Rivera's insurance authorization specifies that the hospital's multidisciplinary genetics service is the covered provider for this referral; a standard community genetics visit would not satisfy the authorization. Dr. Ellis reviewed the authorization in the counseling work queue, but it has not been attached to the scheduling record.

PF2.text: Chen's insurer has already approved an appointment with Northside Genetics for Tuesday at 2:00 PM, and transportation has been booked for that visit. Noah confirmed both arrangements with the insurer and transport vendor, but they are not yet documented in the hospital referral record.

acceptance_conditions: The hospital's Wednesday slot must be assigned to Rivera.
Rivera's referral provider must be recorded as a hospital multidisciplinary genetics service.
Rivera's insurance authorization must be attached to the scheduling record.
Chen's referral must be recorded as Northside Genetics rather than the hospital genetics service.
Chen's alternate appointment must be recorded for Tuesday at 2:00 PM.
A commitment must document Chen's Northside Genetics appointment and transportation.
The authorization fact supporting Rivera's assignment must be cited.

content_checks.C6: any('Northside Genetics' in c['detail'] and 'appointment' in c['detail'] and 'transportation' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Rivera's authorization makes a hospital multidisciplinary genetics service the required covered provider, changing the slot assignment to Rivera, the recorded provider to that hospital service, and the authorization field to true.

Chen's approved Northside Genetics appointment and booked transportation change the alternate provider to Northside Genetics, fix the appointment at Tuesday 2:00 PM, and require documentation naming the appointment and transportation.
